def solve():

def guessFrac(n, mod):
    min_val = mod
    argnum = -1
    argden = 0
    for den in range(1, 200001):
        num = (n * den) % mod
        if num * 2 >= mod:
            num -= mod
        if abs(num) + den < min_val:
            min_val = abs(num) + den
            argnum = num
            argden = den
    if argden == 0:
        return None
    return [argnum, argden]

def invl(a, mod):
    b = mod
    p = 1
    q = 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a = b
        b = d % b
        d = p
        p = q
        q = d - c * q
    return p % mod
